subject.title: refactor(channels): separate status output from snapshot input

question: Should OpenClaw close the public Gateway channel account status output to the declared ChannelAccountStatus schema now, while preserving ChannelAccountSnapshot as a deprecated input alias for one migration window?
rationale: The patch is technically coherent, but choosing to stop exposing undeclared per-account status fields is a public plugin/Gateway compatibility decision that automation should not own.

options.title: Accept closed status output
options.body: Merge this direction after maintainer review, treating undeclared per-account fields as plugin/runtime input that must be projected or promoted deliberately.

options.title: Preserve extension output fields
options.body: Require a narrower compatibility layer or schema extension point before merge for existing clients that depend on channel-specific account status fields.

options.title: Pause for API review
options.body: Keep the branch open until channel/plugin SDK owners decide the deprecation window and any public schema additions.

recommendation.title: Accept closed status output
recommendation.body: Merge this direction after maintainer review, treating undeclared per-account fields as plugin/runtime input that must be projected or promoted deliberately.
